BARNES KEITH RANCH'S RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA TSC's CORRECTED
         LIST OF INTERVENORS WHO DID NOT FILE TESTIMONY
                    OR A STATEMENT OF POSITION

       On May 19,2026, Oncor and LCRA TSC's filed a Corrected List of Intervenors Who Did

Not File Testimony or a Statement of Position. In that corrected list, Oncor and LCRA erred in

identifying Barnes Keith Ranch as a party that did not file testimony or a statement of position.

Barnes Keith Ranch timely filed the testimony of Robert V. Keith on May 13, 2026, as

interchange item number 4304. The first page of the testimony states that it is being provided on

behalf of Barnes Keith Ranch.

       Bames Keith Ranch maintains that it has preserved its intervenor party status and moves

for Oncor and LCRA to correct the erroneous filing.
